note: Routing work zones for the R12 AVA re-layout (ROUTING_PLAN.md section 6). Board mm, x east, y forward from the aft edge. A zone owns every copper layer inside its polygon except where a 'strips' entry gives one layer of a rectangle to another zone. Copper may cross a zone border only at a listed hand-off point. D-R12-96: the W1 / W2 border moved from y 26.5 to y 17.0-17.6 so that the 3V3 buck cell (moved 4.6 mm aft) lies wholly in W2, as ROUTING_PLAN assigns it; RAW_PROTECTED hands off W1 -> W2 on B 0.6 mm at (45.2, 17.0). R12F4-TRI-08: W5 closes at the 90 mm outline (y 90, Edge.Cuts; it ended at y 100 from the 46 x 100 mm stage), and zone_guard.py refuses any zone polygon or fragment point outside Edge.Cuts. R12F5-TRI-13: W3 / W5 brought to the 90 mm layout (D-R12-99 moved the port row and its 1 k / 100 nF cells 10 mm aft, the microSD block 5.4 mm aft and the port buck cell 1.5 mm aft): W3 keeps U1's escape, the microSD block (the old W5 notch at x 11.7-19, y 61.5-66.8), QSPI and the port UART B lanes up to y 80 with F fingers to the 1 k series pads at y 81.77 (x 11.7-13.4, 22.1-26.2, 34.6-36.4) and PORT_SENSE to R111.1 (27.2, 80.17); W5 takes the port row forward of y 80, the port buck cell (x >= 39.2 from y 66.3, x >= 37.0 from y 68.6), the 3V3 bulk pocket C461 / C23 / C460 / TP74 (x 28.5-34.6, y 68.6-80) and the west bay x < 11.7. Strip CR ends at the trunk hand-off y 73.1; strip CX (a B AUX lane under the 100 mm port buck) is gone: the AUX lanes run at x 35 / 36 inside W3.

W1.name: aft power, pyro, camera and servo cells

W2.name: east power: 3V3 buck cell, VLOGIC cluster, USB, J2, RAW trunk

W3.name: U1 escape, decouplers, crystal, QSPI, microSD, forward UART bus, AUX lane, In2 sense / NRST lanes

W4.name: sensor stack and aft corridor CA

W5.name: ports, port buck, PORT_4V8, buzzer, LEDs, west bay

strips.what: RAW_PROTECTED trunk, B.Cu 0.6 mm at x 45.2 up to its W5 hand-off at (45.2, 73.1) (inside the W3 / W5 polygons, B only)
BAT_FAULT_N B lane at x 19.2 (inside W4, B only)
3V3A In2 power track (x 13.0) and the NRST In2 lane (x 14.4 / y 45.6) where they pass inside the W1 polygon (In2 only)
